## Summary
- route scored revised attempts through the existing evidence scheduling seam
- make revision resolution attach its scheduler hook and queue-item identities without duplicating scheduled work
- add the named end-to-end regression for accepted revision queue creation

Closes #713

## Validation
- [x] 23 focused feedback and scheduler-wiring tests passed
- [x] Ruff passed for both changed files
- [x] Black check passed for both changed files
- [x] Mypy passed for both changed files
- [x] Deliberate-break verifier passed: the named test failed against origin/main with only the candidate test overlaid and passed at badd2d4

## Acceptance evidence
- [x] test_revision_acceptance_enqueues_review_queue_item creates a due-review queue item for the revised attempt
- [x] resolution records revision_request_id and queue_item_ids in durable scheduler evidence
title: fix(feedback): schedule accepted revision evidence (#713)
